CustomField.description: Staging mirror of GiftTransaction.FQS_Match_Status__c. Both fields source their picklist values from the FQS_Match_Status GlobalValueSet so the launcher staging value always matches what lands on the transaction. Written to GiftTransaction.FQS_Match_Status__c on commit. Tracks the lifecycle of a corporate matching-gift request — Eligible, Request Confirmed, Received, Declined, or N/A.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Where this gift stands in the corporate matching lifecycle. Leave blank or N/A if no match is expected. Complements the boolean Matched field on the transaction, which only flips true once the matching transaction is linked.
CustomField.label: Match Status
